partners.mechanism_chain: COQ6 (HGNC:23786) —DISRUPTS→ Coenzyme Q biosynthesis (GO:0006723); COQ8B (HGNC:20804) —DISRUPTS→ Coenzyme Q biosynthesis (GO:0006723); Coenzyme Q biosynthesis (GO:0006723) —DECREASES→ mitochondrial electron transport chain complex I assembly (GO:0005747); mitochondrial electron transport chain complex I assembly (GO:0005747) —LEADS_TO→ Nephrotic syndrome (HP:0011194); mitochondrial electron transport chain complex I assembly (GO:0005747) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital cataracts facial dysmorphism syndrome (HP:0012450).
